name: Vet CBD | 150mg Dog Treats 30ct | Calming Peanut Butter
description:
Helps Maintain Calmness & Relaxation

For dogs that benefit from ongoing support for relaxation and emotional balance, VetCBD Calming Soft Chews offer a convenient way to help maintain a normal and relaxed disposition. Made with broad-spectrum CBD and L-theanine, these CBD pet treats for dogs help support relaxation and overall emotional well-being. Whether your dog needs routine support or help maintaining a sense of calm during environmental changes like travel, loud noises, or new surroundings, this CBD pet supplement is veterinarian-formulated for consistent support.
